keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Ajax 1, FC Thun 0. Rayane Bounida (Ajax) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Oliver Edvardsen.
Thilo Kehrer (Ajax) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Ajax 2, FC Thun 0. Marcos Leonardo (Ajax) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Abdellah Ouazane following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Jan Bamert (FC Thun).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, FC Thun. Nicolas Bürgy replaces Jan Bamert because of an injury.
First Half ends, Ajax 2, FC Thun 0.
Substitution, Ajax. Steven Berghuis replaces Oliver Edvardsen.
Substitution, Ajax. Mohamed Abdalla replaces Julian Brandt.
Substitution, FC Thun. Tom Strannegård replaces Olivier Mambwa.
Substitution, FC Thun. Nassim Zoukit replaces Mattias Käit.
Substitution, FC Thun. Patrik Kristal replaces Nils Reichmuth.
Goal! Ajax 3, FC Thun 0. Rayane Bounida (Ajax) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Substitution, Ajax. Anton Gaaei replaces Owen Wijndal.
Substitution, Ajax. Youri Baas replaces Abdellah Ouazane.
Substitution, FC Thun. Noah Christoffersson replaces Brighton Labeau.
Substitution, Ajax. Jofre Torrents replaces Sofyan Amrabat.
Furkan Dursun (FC Thun) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Fabio Fehr (FC Thun) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Ajax 4, FC Thun 0. Steven Berghuis (Ajax) left footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Marcos Leonardo.
